source_snapshot.deepseek_finding: DeepSeek correctly refuses to execute a TBD row, but does not use the item name and SEL Device Commands context to identify the standard optional Get Auxiliary Log Status command or separate its read-only capability from the missing log-type and acceptance inputs.

original_test_intent.purpose: Validate the BMC's in-band implementation of the standard IPMI Get Auxiliary Log Status command for an owner-selected supported log type, returning the last-add timestamp and the type-specific MCA or OEM status fields without modifying the auxiliary log.
original_test_intent.target: The exact SUT BMC/firmware's optional Storage command 0x5A over the local in-band IPMI interface, for one explicitly selected log type: MCA (00h), OEM 1 (01h), or OEM 2 (02h).
original_test_intent.scope: After the owner confirms the intended log type and platform support, issue one bounded read for that type, validate completion and type-specific response length, decode the little-endian timestamp and MCA entry count or OEM IANA/status bytes, and compare against the platform's expected support/state. No Set Auxiliary Log Status, log generation, clear or deletion is included.
original_test_intent.operation: Preserve the log baseline; verify BMC identity and command support; send local `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x5a <log-type>` for only the approved type; parse the normative response layout; apply vendor documentation only to OEM status bytes; report supported, unsupported, unspecified and malformed results distinctly; then verify non-mutation.
original_test_intent.duration_and_iterations: The workbook estimates 10 attended and 5 machine minutes but defines no log-type matrix. V3 permits one query per owner-selected type; testing all three types requires an explicit matrix rather than inferred iteration.
original_test_intent.expected_result: For a platform-required supported type, completion is successful and the response has the exact type-specific layout: MCA timestamp plus entry count, or OEM timestamp plus IANA enterprise number and eight OEM status bytes. An unsupported response is acceptable only when the platform declares that optional type unsupported; no log content or status changes.
original_test_intent.required_evidence: Owner intent and selected log type; platform/BMC support statement; BMC/firmware/local-interface identity; exact request, completion and response length; decoded timestamp and MCA count including FFFFFFFFh unspecified handling, or OEM IANA/status bytes with the matching vendor schema; expected-state comparison; before/after non-mutation evidence.
ambiguities: Procedure and Criteria are TBD and do not select MCA, OEM 1 or OEM 2.
The standard defines command framing and MCA fields, but OEM status-byte meaning belongs to the responding IANA enterprise and requires exact firmware documentation.
Get Auxiliary Log Status is optional, so an unsupported completion is not automatically a product failure without a platform support requirement.
The generic pre-test instruction to clear logs conflicts with a read-only status test and would alter the evidence under review.

v2_review_conclusion.finding: V2 correctly prohibits guessing the log type, OEM fields or expected state and rejects log clearing. It incorrectly states that the command and response schema cannot be derived, marks the read as destructive/high risk, and treats missing testcase inputs as permanent capability BLOCKED even though IPMI 2.0 defines standard Storage command 5Ah and its type-specific layouts.

applicable_history.decision: Historical TBD handling did not establish a locked user classification. No decision authorizes mutations or selects an auxiliary-log type.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Reclassify BLOCKED to REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION. The named standard command is a bounded read with a normative request and response schema, so automation is technically feasible; execution remains pending the owner-selected log type, platform support expectation and, for OEM types, matching IANA/vendor status definition.

available_now: The item name and SEL Device Commands context map directly to optional standard Storage command 5Ah.
IPMI 2.0 defines request values 00h MCA, 01h OEM 1 and 02h OEM 2, plus exact MCA and OEM response layouts.
BMC identity, command-support information and preserved log inventory can be gathered read-only without clearing or setting any log status.
missing_inputs: Owner confirmation of the intended log type or finite type matrix and whether support is required for this platform
Expected state/comparison rule for last-add timestamp and MCA entry count, including whether FFFFFFFFh unspecified is allowed
For OEM 1/2, expected IANA enterprise number, exact firmware-specific meaning of all eight OEM status bytes and acceptable values
Qualified local raw runner/parser, target BMC/firmware applicability record and an independent source for correlation when the test is intended to validate content rather than framing
execution_readiness_detail.input_owner: The testcase/platform owner selects the log type and support expectation; the BMC/vendor owner supplies firmware applicability and OEM status definitions; the tool owner supplies the bounded parser and evidence collector.
safe_read_only_work_before_closure: Record BMC/firmware/local-interface identity, inspect documented command support and preserve existing SEL/auxiliary-log evidence without clear or mutation.
Implement and offline-test parsers for the standard MCA and OEM layouts, including unsupported completion, malformed length, special timestamp and unspecified MCA count.
prohibited_until_closed: Do not guess a log type, issue Set Auxiliary Log Status 5Bh, generate machine checks, clear/delete logs, change enablement/retention, interpret OEM bytes using a different vendor's schema or mark optional unsupported behavior FAIL without a support requirement.
Do not treat command completion alone as health, expose sensitive OEM status content unnecessarily or expand this read case into fault injection.
execution_readiness_detail.closure_verification: The owner signs the log-type/support/acceptance matrix; exact BMC firmware applicability is recorded; OEM cases include matching IANA documentation; the parser validates type-specific length and special values; evidence collection proves only Get 5Ah is issued and no log state changes.

revision_candidate.test_name: In-Band IPMI Get Auxiliary Log Status for an Approved Log Type
revision_candidate.purpose: Read and validate the standard auxiliary-log status fields for the owner-selected MCA or OEM log type through the local BMC interface without changing, clearing or generating log data.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: The exact server/BMC firmware documenting support for optional Storage command 5Ah and the selected log type, with a working local IPMI system interface and the correct OEM schema when applicable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Only the signed type 00h, 01h or 02h query and its current returned status. Set Auxiliary Log Status, fault injection, log creation, retention changes, deletion and clearing are outside scope.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Selected log type/type matrix; platform support requirement; expected timestamp/count or OEM state; BMC/firmware identity; local interface and qualified `ipmitool`; OEM IANA/status schema where applicable; special-value policy; correlation source and redaction rule.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Preserve the current evidence and verify the BMC. Send one local `ipmitool raw 0x0a 0x5a <00|01|02>` request for the approved type. Validate completion and exact data length; decode the four-byte little-endian last-add timestamp and either the four-byte MCA count or three-byte OEM IANA plus eight status bytes; compare with the signed platform expectation and independent evidence, then confirm no log state changed.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Owner-selected log type and support expectation documented; exact BMC/firmware and local interface verified; parser matches the normative layout; OEM IANA/schema present for OEM types; logs preserved; no Set/Clear/Delete or fault-generation step included.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Signed type/support matrix; BMC/firmware/tool identity; timestamped exact request and completion; response length and raw bytes; decoded timestamp, MCA count/special value or OEM IANA/status fields; platform/reference comparison; unsupported-versus-failure interpretation; non-mutation audit.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Intel IPMI 2.0 rev. 1.1 section 31.12/Table 31-12 and Appendix G Storage command 5Ah, plus the exact platform support statement and IANA-owner firmware schema for OEM status bytes.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Never clear, delete, set or generate log content; do not guess types, probe reserved values, reuse another vendor's OEM map, treat an optional unsupported type as a defect without the platform requirement or disclose sensitive status fields outside approved evidence.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: No runtime safety approval is required for the authorized read-only query. The testcase/platform owner must first provide the missing type and expected-support/acceptance decision.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: The owner selects the target type and judges undocumented OEM meaning. Once those inputs exist, command execution, structural decoding, supported-state comparison and non-mutation evidence are automatable.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: No recovery is expected. On target mismatch, unsupported type, malformed response or correlation conflict, stop, preserve evidence and correct the input/schema; do not issue a Set, Clear, Delete or fault-generation command to force a result.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Missing type/support expectation; wrong BMC/firmware; reserved log type; absent matching OEM IANA schema; command failure where support is required; unexpected response length; invalid timestamp/count/status encoding; target ambiguity; or any request to mutate or generate log state.

identified_defects: V2 overlooks the standard Storage 5Ah definition available from the testcase name and test-set context.
V2 labels a Get-only command destructive and high risk without evidence of read side effects.
The source lacks the required log-type and optional-support expectation, while V2 does not distinguish standard MCA decoding from vendor-owned OEM status interpretation.
The source's clear-log setup contradicts the read-only intent and would destroy the reference state.
reason_for_change: Use the normative IPMI command definition to separate a solvable input/spec gap from a genuine semantic blocker. V3 still forbids execution while type and acceptance are TBD, but recognizes that the read path is automatable and non-destructive once the platform owner selects the supported log type and supplies OEM semantics where needed.

new_technical_evidence.title: Intelligent Platform Management Interface Specification v2.0 rev. 1.1 E7 Markup
new_technical_evidence.version: 2.0 rev. 1.1, Errata 7; section 31.12/Table 31-12 and Appendix G
new_technical_evidence.applicability: BMCs implementing optional Storage command 5Ah for MCA or OEM auxiliary logs
new_technical_evidence.supports: The Get command accepts log type 00h/01h/02h. MCA returns last-add timestamp and entry count; OEM types return timestamp, IANA enterprise number and eight OEM-defined status bytes. Unsupported types return an error, and Get may exist without the separate Set command.
new_technical_evidence.remaining_uncertainty: This platform's command/type support, selected target, expected status and OEM byte definitions remain owner/vendor-specific.

removed_ambiguities: Identifies the exact standard command instead of treating the title as an unknown OEM operation.
Separates MCA's standard fields from OEM status bytes owned by the returned IANA enterprise.
Separates an optional unsupported type from malformed behavior or violation of a platform support requirement.
resolved_blockers: The command, request values and response framing are normatively defined, so Procedure/Criteria TBD does not make automation permanently impossible.
Get 5Ah is a read-only capability and does not require approval for mutation.
remaining_blockers: Execution remains pending the owner-selected log type, support expectation and acceptance criteria; OEM types additionally require the exact IANA/vendor schema.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 corrects the false destructive/BLOCKED characterization with a byte-accurate standard read contract while retaining a hard readiness gate for the unresolved log type and OEM acceptance semantics.

agent_understanding_result.notes: The BLOCKED-to-REQUIRES reclassification and MCA-versus-OEM boundary are queued for isolated understanding validation.
